summary: Full-coverage secret scan of all restored documentation (50 files: 26 in docs/, 24 in .claude/skills/project-knowledge/recovered/, including 4 PDF copies — 2 unique PDFs extracted with pdftotext) found zero secrets, zero API keys, zero private keys, zero internal infrastructure references, and zero accidentally-captured sensitive material. The single Solana base58 string detected (`MemoSq4gqABAXKb96qnH8TysNcWxMyWCqXgDLGmfcHr` in agent-identity.txt:156) is the public Solana SPL Memo program ID — a well-known on-chain program address with no associated private key, intentionally cited as a protocol primitive. All HTTP(S) URLs encountered are public references (arxiv, GitHub, W3C, Ethereum/Solana docs, HuggingFace public datasets, anthropic.com, x402.org, blog/research sites). The single `https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com` endpoint in agent-identity PDF is the public Solana mainnet RPC (a documented config example, not infra). Token-replacement focus areas (DRAG_ANALYSIS, WEB_RESEARCH_TRUSTLESS_RAG, CONCURRENT_WRITERS, ARWEAVE_PRICING_VALIDATION) contain no hard-coded keys/addresses, no redacted-looking strings, no env-var assignments, no PEM headers, no Telegram bot tokens, no AWS/Cloudflare/GitHub/Anthropic/OpenAI/HuggingFace tokens. PDFs scanned via pdftotext (poppler 26.01.0).
